title: VPCs and subnets
summary: A Virtual Private Cloud is a network space you configure. A subnet is a range of network addresses inside that VPC and one Availability Zone.
introduction: A Virtual Private Cloud is a network space you configure. A subnet is a range of network addresses inside that VPC and one Availability Zone. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: A Virtual Private Cloud is a network space you configure. A subnet is a range of network addresses inside that VPC and one Availability Zone.

blocks.code:
VPC range: 10.0.0.0/16
Example subnet: 10.0.1.0/24
Location: one chosen Availability Zone
blocks.title: VPCs and subnets

blocks.text: The subnet is a smaller address range within the VPC. The numbers are a planning example, not a command.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: Do not overlap address ranges without understanding the network consequences.
For more detail later, use this [AWS further reading](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/aws-overview/introduction.html).
